blocks.text:
After breakfast, the excursion through the national park begins. The route passes sandstone cliffs, vegetation and waterfalls, whose shapes have been sculpted by wind and rain.

The walk ends at the Bridal Veil waterfall. Along the route, sandstone formations stand among dense vegetation, with the sound of water and birdsong accompanying much of the walk. This day offers a chance to experience Chapada dos Guimarães as a combination of canyons, waterfalls and savanna, rather than a single stop between transfers. Lunch at a local restaurant follows, before the transfer to Cuiabá. Overnight in the city.
